title: A2v10 <name>.operation.json (operation of a document)
description: One operation of a document: document/<x>/<name>.operation.json, listed in 'operations' of document/<x>/metadata.json. An operation is what the user switches inside an open document, so it holds only what is re-evaluated on a switch - 'post'. Birth and address (initialValues, autonum, fixed, forms, traits) belong to the document. The rules of an operation are not generated yet and are refused at load.

description.description: For the model, not the platform: nothing reads it - no generator, runtime or deploy.

post.description: What posting a document of this operation does - the same entries as 'post' of a document. Exactly one 'post' is in force at the moment of posting: the one of the operation the document carries.
